text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Top contenders gather at the Champions Cup 
every year. To defeat any opponent, 
Transcend pushed through training right to 
the very limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, she receives supportive 
messages. With Transcend at the center, a 
circle has expanded, forming a true 
"network of empathy."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to overcome any hardship and 
bring hope to all, Transcend sets out to 
claim consecutive victories!
